issues.reason: The Time section states that an event-noun serving only as the anchor of an after/before adjunct "gets its class atom and the ordering relation and nothing else — no tense or status of its own", and (Past sk_night_1) is exactly that forbidden status atom; the modifiers inside the NP do not make the night an argument the clause predicates of.

(Measure <entity> <scale> <magnitude> <unit>) is a one-place property, so (Measure benton_harbor distance (ParticleFromNormal 100 10) mile) asserts that Benton Harbor has an absolute ~100-mile "distance" — content the text never states (it states a distance from Chicago), failing the Core-patterns "point at the words that put the atom there" test.

gaps_confirmed: a measured distance BETWEEN two entities — Measure is one-place over an entity and no two-place distance form exists, so "about 100 miles northeast of Chicago" can carry the direction but not the magnitude
a subject possessive on an event-denoting noun ("Jackson's visit") — the genitive rule offers only PartOf or Possession and never licenses the Agent role the parse uses
"came after" as a light verb over an event noun — the light-verb list is occurred / happened / took place
new_gaps: an indefinite, modified time-period NP as an ordering anchor ("a relatively peaceful night in Benton Harbor") — the Time section covers calendar terms, deictics and event-nouns, but gives no encoding for a period noun that also carries a property, a degree and a place, so the witness + Member + Degree + Location treatment is improvisation

an approximate hedge attached to a relation rather than an entity — ParticleFromNormal is defined only inside a Measure magnitude slot, so once the unanchored Measure is dropped the "about" of "about 100 miles" has nowhere to live
repair_summary: Removed (Past sk_night_1) — a temporal-anchor event-noun takes no tense or status of its own. Removed (Measure benton_harbor distance (ParticleFromNormal 100 10) mile) — there is no licensed two-place distance form, so the unanchored measure is deleted rather than replaced with an invention.
notes: The night's peaceful / Degree / Location atoms are stated content read off the words and stay; only the status atom the rule names is removed. The magnitude of the Chicago distance is now unrecorded, which is the registered gap — (NortheastOf benton_harbor chicago) keeps the relation and is licensed as a CamelCase-joined multi-word surface preposition.
